findings.message: Editorial gain units and the Luna expansion heading wrap more than ideal but remain readable; these are nonblocking polish opportunities.
The lavender cover eyebrow is less prominent than its title; midnight body headings remain heavy. Neither obscures required content in the reviewed renders.
